playful_marimba: Instrumental music for a 60-second trailer of a cheerful video game about math, from grade 3 arithmetic to college calculus, played as fast WarioWare-style microgames with cute animals. Exactly 150 BPM, steady tempo, major key, curious, clever, joyful and bouncy. No vocals. A short sparkling 3-second intro, an energetic groove, a brief quieter build around 20 to 30 seconds, a big happy chorus starting at 32 seconds, and a clean ending with one bright final hit at 60 seconds. Bouncy marimba, pizzicato strings, glockenspiel, ukulele, handclaps and light drums.
